name: Artifact Operator
summary: Manages opaque immutable artifact finalization and integrity outcomes without owning a storage provider.
description: Uses opaque content and artifact references, retention classes, integrity evidence, and idempotency keys to govern artifact handling. Does not choose a filesystem, object store, database, provider, or credential.

distinguished_from.how: Owns immutable byte-asset outcomes; does not own versioned record transitions.
Owns artifact lifecycle boundaries; does not configure audio source or transformation policy.
